tagline: Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, hex and any base instantly
pageDescription: Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal and any base from 2 to 36 with this free online Number Base Converter. See every representation update instantly as you type, switch the input base, and use the bit-width and signed two’s complement options to inspect how values are stored at 8, 16, 32 or 64 bits. Backed by big-integer math, so even very large numbers convert exactly. Perfect for developers, CS students and anyone working with hex, binary or low-level data — no signup, runs in your browser.

instructions.title: How to convert number bases

steps.title: Enter your number
steps.description: Type a number in the input field. Prefixes like 0x, 0b and 0o are accepted, and you can use underscores or spaces as separators.

steps.title: Choose the input base
steps.description: Pick Binary, Octal, Decimal or Hexadecimal, or set any custom base from 2 to 36 with the small base selector.

steps.title: Read the conversions
steps.description: All bases update instantly — decimal, hex, octal, binary, and your custom base if you used one.

steps.title: Set bit width and sign (optional)
steps.description: Choose 8, 16, 32 or 64 bits to wrap the value, and toggle Signed to interpret it as two’s complement.

steps.title: Copy any result
steps.description: Click the copy icon next to any representation to copy it to your clipboard.

Binary is base 2 and hexadecimal is base 16, so a base 2 to base 16 conversion is just binary to hex

troubleshooting: Invalid digit error: the input contains a digit not allowed in the chosen base
Unexpected value: check the input base matches how you typed the number
Negative shown as large number: enable Signed with a bit width for two’s complement
Signed toggle disabled: choose a bit width first (signed needs a fixed width)
Nothing converts: make sure the field isn’t empty and the base is 2–36
